Why: an EP3 agonist relieves pain in inflamed joints
Note: EP3 on DRG and spinal neurons is antinociceptive in the inflamed joint through Gi, and an EP3 agonist reduces the pain; not an OA model, EP3 seen in joint nerves of patients with painful OA.
Evidence: joint inflammation model (rat), human OA joint nerves
References: Natura G et al. Neuronal prostaglandin E2 receptor subtype EP3 mediates antinociception during inflammation. Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A 110(33):13648-53. 2013. doi: 10.1073/pnas.1300820110. PMID: 23904482.
